description: Model comparison (CONTEXT.md): one reference configuration (Opus 5.5, medium) against two candidates (Haiku 5.5, high; Sonnet 5.5, medium), three runs each, same prompt and golden set. Not a Baseline: eval/thresholds.yaml was derived from eval/baseline-2026-09-29.json, and this file changes no threshold.

thresholds_applied.note: unchanged from eval/thresholds.yaml; every hard gate applied as in the eval runner

extra_opus_run.note: Fourth Opus run, not part of the reference spread (the reference is the three CI runs). Run by accident on 2026-10-19 when CVR_LABEL_* was set inline on the smoke-run line only, so the three intended Haiku runs used the default Opus config; this one was kept.

notes: The sides differ in effort as well as model: Opus 5.5 at medium (the reference), Haiku 5.5 at high, Sonnet 5.5 at medium. Haiku was given high to have a fair chance; Sonnet matches the reference, so Sonnet and Opus differ only in the model. Read each comparison as one between configurations.
Prompt 1.3.0 and schema 1.0.0 on all nine runs; 48 documents and 48 live calls each, cache never read, zero retries.

Both 5.5 candidates needed max_tokens 128000, set through CVR_LABEL_EXTRA='{"max_tokens": 128000}', because the locked langchain-anthropic has a model profile for claude-opus-5-5 but none for claude-haiku-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5 and falls back to 4,096 (the first Haiku smoke run was cut off at exactly 4,096 output tokens). Opus needs no override. Whichever candidate becomes the default must carry that cap in code.

Haiku failed all three runs on hard gates: 2, 4, 3 wrongful removals (runs 1 to 3) and structural placement misses in runs 2 and 3. Three patterns. (1) RM_REFEREE removes c04's content line 'with a reference available' (all three runs). (2) RM_PERSONAL removes c07's 'EU citizen' (runs 2 and 3). (3) Quotes clipped at commas and clause ends (c05, c08, c12 and c10: for example ', Moylish', ', Bray', ' (hybrid)', and sentence tails left to the appendix), which drops structural leaves in c05, c08 and c12 and pushes the appendix rate to 1.09 to 1.34% against Opus's 0.70%. No added or dropped text, provenance, PII, image, ordering or labelling failure in any Haiku run.

Sonnet passed every gate on every run with every hard-gate count at zero (added, dropped, wrongful removals, provenance, PII, images, ordering, punctuation, labelling failures, errors). Structural placement 100/100 in all three runs. Its only systematic difference from Opus: it files c04's second profile paragraph, 'Recently relocated to Dublin and available at short notice.', under Additional instead of Profile (3 of 4 Layouts in runs 1 and 2, all 4 in run 3). In run 1 it also split c10's text-box profile between Profile and Additional. No wording is lost; these are section choices and the only tunable misses.
Extra Opus run, kept out of the reference spread: claude-opus-5-5 at medium, 2026-10-19, prompt 1.3.0, PASS, $3.3247, 217.8 s (see extra_opus_run).

Price table (cvr.label.pricing), checked 2026-10-19: Sonnet 5.5 $2 in and $10 out per million tokens; Haiku 5.5 from the same ticket-01 entry. Cost in every report is the labelling cost from that table.

verdict.rule: Spec: any hard-gate breach, wrongful removal, labelling failure or non-provider error in any run disqualifies a candidate; thresholds applied unchanged; above the gate the call is the maintainer's, on the side-by-side numbers.

haiku.reasoning: Failed the hard gates in all three runs (wrongful removals 2 to 4 per run; structural recall 99.72 to 100.0). Cheaper ($0.1403 to $0.1418 a run) but not an acceptable trade for removed content lines. Maintainer's verdict: a wide gap; Haiku as configured is out. A Haiku-specific prompt approach might be tried later; nothing is planned.

sonnet.reasoning: Passed every gate on every run with every hard-gate count at zero. Structural 100/100; tunable precision 99.56 to 99.73, recall 99.65 to 99.73 (reference 99.91 to 100.0 and 99.91 to 100.0), against the unchanged 98% threshold; appendix rate 0.7% (reference 0.7%, threshold 2%). Cost $1.5925 to $1.5932 a run against $3.3161 to $3.3306 for Opus, 52% less; wall time 138.5 to 163.3 s against 213.6 to 237.8 s. The price is slightly lower tunable placement from the c04 section choice, with no loss of text.

verdict.recommendation: Make claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium the default labeller (with max_tokens 128000 carried in code).

maintainer_decision.haiku: A wide gap; move on to Sonnet 5.5 (ticket 06).
maintainer_decision.sonnet: Make Sonnet 5.5 at medium the default (ticket 04).
